name: Pedra com entalhes anões
prompt: Create ONE opaque square material texture for a medieval fantasy battlemap FLOOR. Camera exactly vertically above at 90 degrees, orthographic, no perspective. Finely hand-painted realistic game art matching warm textured timber and natural stone from a high-quality overhead VTT library. Delicate material grain, crisp small-scale detail, natural muted colors. Neutral even overhead lighting across the entire image, no central highlight, vignette or directional shadow. Fill every pixel edge-to-edge with the SAME continuous floor material. Seamless repeat on all four edges. No frame, border, room, walls, furniture, objects, ground patch, text, watermark, grid overlay or transparency. Material: dark gray fine-grained stone floor slabs with thin weathered brass inlay forming restrained repeating angular geometric bands, no runes or writing, dense elegant pattern.
